body: I'm thinking about write a new formatter (likely going to be a future addition to cython-lint) and in doing so I thought about ensuring that the current `CodeWriter` has it's current scope expanded by looking into some unimplemented stuff. Luckily I have already found a few and I've written another test module since so I could attempt to unit test for missing items.

comment_data.body:
Now you've removed `endline` from `CFuncDeclaratorNode` this seems identical to the contests of `visit_CFuncDeclaratorNode`.

It might be worth thinking about where else `CFuncDeclaratorNode` can be used? Possibly `cdef extern` blocks? Do your changes break that?

         self.visit(node.declarator.base)
         self.put('(')
         self.comma_separated_list(node.declarator.args)
-        self.endline('):')
+        self.put(')')
